scenario: [LUNI.16.2]'s `units.chemistry`, compiled as it ships: the standard library is on every fixture's search path and there is no `libraries` copy ([RCTS.1.2.14]), so this fails if the shipped `stdlib/units/chemistry.ds` stops compiling or stops declaring `pH`. `pH` is used as a literal against a `molar_h` slot, its base (tier-2 non-affine, [LUNI.4.3]); `units.chemistry` imports `proportion` from `units.si`, so that import is compiled too.
rules_ds:
from units.chemistry import molar_h, pH

schema Sample scope logical:
    id: String key
    h: molar_h mutable

rule acidic:
    Sample s where s.h > 7_pH
->
    log info "acidic"
